children: INNOVATE advanced its deleveraging plan by obtaining holder consent for a Supplemental Indenture that mandates redemption of its 9.500% Convertible Senior Secured Notes due 2027 after the lock-up on stock consideration ends. Concurrently, the company repaid and terminated two credit facilities tied to the DBM Global transaction: a $20.7 million payoff to close its own revolving line with MSD PCOF Partners IX and a $68.7 million payoff to terminate DBM Global's credit agreement led by UMB Bank. These steps reduce near-term obligations and set up mandatory redemption of the Convertible Notes using deal proceeds and potential stock sale proceeds.
Agreement 1: Innovate Obtains Consent for Supplemental Indenture Mandating Convertible Note Redemption
: Supplemental indenture amending 9.500% Convertible Senior Secured Notes due 2027
: Convertible noteholders; U.S. Bank Trust Company (trustee)
: Enable mandatory redemption of Convertible Notes after lock-up
Agreement 2: Innovate Repays $20.7 Million and Terminates Revolving Credit Line With MSD PCOF Partners IX
: Repaid with proceeds from DBM Global sale
Agreement 3: DBM Global Repays $68.7 Million and Terminates Credit Agreement Led by UMB Bank
: Amended and Restated Credit Agreement (revolver and term loan)
: Repaid at closing of DBM Global sale
